PROTEGE: Vanguard Defense Cyber LLC (51% owner, Responsible Manager Marcus Vance, performs 44% of JV labor). MENTOR: Aegis Global Federal Corp (49% owner, SBA MPA #MPA-2025-8841, performs 56% of JV labor).
